title: Adjacent scalar quotients are normalized
statement: For any sheaf M of integral coefficient modules on any scheme X, let Q_n be the actual cokernel of multiplication by varpi^(n+1), using the coefficients of [def-per-integral-lisse-reduction-data]. The canonical map Q_(n+1) to Q_n is itself the cokernel of multiplication by varpi^(n+1) on Q_(n+1). No local freeness assumption is required.

proof.text: The smaller scalar kills the transition: precompose with the epic larger quotient map and use scalar naturality and the smaller cokernel equation. Every map from the larger quotient killed by the smaller scalar descends from M through the smaller cokernel. The resulting factorization follows after cancelling the larger quotient projection. The transition is epic because its composite with that projection is the smaller cokernel projection, so the factorization is unique. This includes the zero module and empty base.
